summary: fix(auth): prune orphaned Redis session entries on session reads
description:
Because:

- Cached Redis session entries stay after the MySQL token is gone.
- The Lua prune script had no WATCH-based TypeScript equivalent.

This commit:

- Replaces pruneSessionTokens_1 with WATCH/GET/MULTI/EXEC on a duplicate() connection.
- Sets autoResendUnfulfilledCommands false so a reconnect cannot replay MULTI/EXEC alone.
- Makes db.sessions prune cached entries that have no MySQL row.
- Counts and reports a failed prune with a statsd counter and Sentry, without throwing.
- Adds specs for each path.

Closes FXA-14945
